about: APAR Industries Limited engages in the electrical and metallurgical engineering business in India and internationally. It operates through Conductor, Transformer & Specialties Oils, Power/Telecom Cables, and Others segments. The company offers transformer oils, including naphthenic and iso--paraffinic grades; liquid paraffins that are used in baby oil, medical and pharma, cosmetic, food packaging and coating, personal care, bakery, and plastic industries; petroleum jelly for use in personal care
